from tools import get_results_from_cache, save_to_cache, search_flights, filter_flights, search_hotels, filter_hotels, search_nearest

# Retrieve cached flight results
departure_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="departure_flights")
return_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="return_flights")

# Filter departure flights for economy class and kid-friendly airlines
filtered_departure_flights = filter_flights(
    prior_results=departure_flights,
    flight_class=["economy"]
)
save_to_cache(key="filtered_departure_flights", value=filtered_departure_flights)

# Filter return flights for economy class and kid-friendly airlines
filtered_return_flights = filter_flights(
    prior_results=return_flights,
    flight_class=["economy"]
)
save_to_cache(key="filtered_return_flights", value=filtered_return_flights)

# Search for family-friendly hotels in St. Louis
hotels = search_hotels(
    city="St. Louis",
    checkin_date=["2026-06-05"],
    checkout_date=["2026-06-12"]
)
save_to_cache(key="hotels", value=hotels)

# Find nearest hotels to the flights
nearest_hotels = search_nearest(
    hotels=hotels,
    groupBy="hotel"
)
save_to_cache(key="nearest_hotels", value=nearest_hotels)
